title: Vizsla, the Florist
dek: A flower-shop owner who argues that adventurers’ contributions should be recognized without displacing the settlement’s residents.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
A trade and a memory

Vizsla identifies herself as the owner of a small flower shop in Pristinia. Earlier, she reminds Orrik of adventurers’ help at Fernir’s funeral and during an attack. She can challenge their political influence while remembering what particular people have done for the town.

Representation and deadlock

At the public governance debate she worries that a six-person council could deadlock and that three adventurer seats would surrender too much local control. She proposes reducing those seats to two. The proposal expresses her view of representation; it is not presented here as the enacted settlement constitution.

An ordinary life continues

She lends Eli Voss a sickle while holding him to the work he promised, then returns to pruning peonies. Her later remarks about an arena contest explicitly rely on what other people said because she did not attend. Work, humor and the limits of her knowledge all remain visible.

Recorded scenes

  • Remembering the adventurers’ help
  • A borrowed sickle and work owed
  • A florist’s proposal about representation
  • Secondhand knowledge of the arena
